headline.text: Hard plastic fragment found in *L1 S3 jar* during production — personnel caught it, investigation open.

summary: Two active holds: L1 pallet with low salt (second occurrence this month) held for rework at L3, and L1 V2 Mexico macadamia labels held for regulatory non-compliance. L3 truffle line down most of 3rd shift for wire mesh replacement after 1/2 inch chocolate build-up caused equipment failure.

holds.title: V2 Mexico macadamia labels on regulatory hold
holds.summary: All V2 labels for Mexico macadamia clusters fail Mexico labeling requirements and cannot be used; affected LPNs flagged in NetSuite, QA hold tags requested.
holds.status: Hold tags pending; L1 will run V1 labels then switch to US market to avoid using non-compliant V2.

holds.title: S4 pallet held for low salt content
holds.summary: Third-shift pallet flagged by day-shift QA for salt below spec; will be mixed with adequate-salt product at L3 for rework — this is the second occurrence this month.
holds.status: On hold pending rework at L3.

holds.title: Chocolate barrels in heating cabinet pending QA inspection
holds.summary: Multiple barrels of item 10200 in ML2 heating cabinet require one-by-one QA inspection after one barrel was rejected for wrong appearance and discarded.
holds.status: Barrels still cold; QA will inspect each when pulled to line.

food_safety.title: Hard plastic fragment found in S3 jar
food_safety.summary: Production personnel identified foreign material — hard plastic, possibly from tray edge — inside a jar during run; QA notified, piece isolated.
food_safety.status: Investigation open; no contamination path identified yet.

food_safety.title: Wrong flowwrap roll found on ML4 TG5
food_safety.summary: Previous product's flowwrap film still mounted on TG5 at start of new run; removed before any product wrapped.
food_safety.status: Resolved — roll removed, no product affected.

quality.title: ML2 chocolate barrels rejected for quality
quality.summary: One barrel of item 10200 rejected and discarded for wrong appearance; compatible chocolate 10226 substituted, new WO created.
quality.status: Rejected barrel discarded; additional barrels in heating cabinet await inspection.

quality.title: S4 east-side lines: recurring height variance
quality.summary: Two lines on S4 east side ran tall pieces causing jams and rejects; operator raised tunnel temp and resolved, but this is a recurring issue.

quality.title: S2 checkweigher rejecting bags weighed 2-at-a-time
quality.summary: Checkweigher accuracy issue causing false rejects; maintenance adjusted arm speed during pause to clear accumulation.
quality.status: Adjustment made; 6 bins of accumulation remained when makeup ran out on matrix 6.

sanitation.title: Truffle line: 1/2 inch chocolate build-up caused wire mesh failure
sanitation.summary: During wire mesh replacement, maintenance discovered 1/2 inch chocolate build-up on return trough — cleaning gap led to mesh snagging and breaking in 6+ places.
sanitation.status: Resolved — new wire mesh installed, build-up cleaned; line down 3rd shift into 1st shift for repair.

sanitation.title: Cleaning area found dirty at shift start
sanitation.summary: Sanitation staging area found in unsatisfactory condition by incoming crew; photo documented.

opportunities.text: Consider adding salt content verification to S4 line startup or early-run QA sampling protocol — based on today's pallet hold and Curt's note that this is the second low-salt occurrence this month.
Consider visual inspection protocol for barrel chocolate before use — based on today's rejection and discard of item 10200 barrels for wrong appearance at ML2.
Consider adding enrober return trough inspection to truffle line cleaning checklist — based on today's wire mesh failure caused by 1/2 inch chocolate build-up that went undetected during cleaning.
Consider adding film verification to ML4 TG changeover checklist — based on today's wrong flowwrap roll found still mounted on TG5 at product start.
